body:
**What changed**
- **Recommended mod:** the Mods page now has a card at the very top for one recommended mod, apart from your own mods. The app looks for a new version of it at every start.
- **One click:** the button on the card installs the mod. When the mod needs it, the same click installs or updates UE4SS first. Once installed, it is a normal mod: you can turn it off or uninstall it.
- **UE4SS C++ BYPASS** is the first recommended mod. The game's update of 2026-11-04 made the game refuse changed scripts, which broke script-based pak mods. This mod brings them back. It is experimental for now and needs further testing, and it is tied to one exact game build and UE4SS build.
- **Technical notes:** the blue box on the card explains how the mod works and where its source code is.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.5.3.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
